# Deck

The deliverable is one HTML deck: the user asked for slides, a presentation or a PPT, or the skeleton declares `od.mode: deck`. For a pptx call the presentations plugin. Then [check](check.md).

## What a deck owes

- One `{项目名}.html`: 1920×1080 slides (1024×768 when the skill says 4:3) in a frame that scales with the viewport, never a vertical long page.
- Each slide a real `<section class="slide">` (the host's design mode counts slides by it) with its page number; ← / → and Space page, leaving keys to forms and editable content; landscape print styles; no phone or tablet frame.
- A deck to be presented carries `<aside class="notes">` or `data-speaker-notes` per slide, written as script to be spoken; a deck to be read needs none.
